Name: Clean Greenhouse
Author: Lerura
Description:
A cleaned up greenhouse.

Comes in 6 versions:

For Iridium Sprinklers
15x15 : One big 15x15 field
5x5x4 : 4 5x5 fields
5x5x9 : 9 5x5 fields

For Prismatic Sprinklers ( available with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools[/url] )
21x21 : One big 21x21 field
7x7x4 : 4 7x7 fields
7x7x9 : 9 7x7 fields

Watering Can can be filled from the barrel at the back wall.
You must go through a short passage to get to the actual greenhouse.

Current versions are with no space for trees, but if you like this clean and compact design and want other sizes or versions with space for trees, please post it in the Posts section.

Requires SMAPI v2.11.3 or higher, and Content Patcher v1.9 or higher.

To Install:
Unzip the content of the file to [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Run the game once to create the config. json
In config.json you can choose the desired version.
